meaning: The first completed v0.3.0 sample ended successfully, but its plan and queue already existed before v0.3.0. The next Taskledger session after this timestamp will begin from a brand-new specification and will be the first sample that exercises v0.3.0 planning as well as execution.

timeline.next_sample_kind: brand-new specification, planning, materialization, execution, verification, and completion

interpretation_policy.description: Treat this as a chronological phase marker, not as an instruction to discard or reset earlier evidence. Future analysis should extend the existing series and label the already-queued run separately from the first brand-new planning run.

required: The root Taskledger task begins after the checkpoint timestamp.
The rollout injects Taskledger skill metadata version 0.3.0 or later and the installed CLI reports the same intended version.
A new specification is supplied and planning is not merely resumed from an already-materialized queue.
The run includes the v0.3.0 planning approvals, ledger materialization, plan validation, and at least one assignment.
Primary and worker model settings are recorded from runtime turn context.
preferred: At least three tasks complete in one comparable family; a broader conclusion needs multiple families or roughly 15-20 tasks.
No model or reasoning-effort changes occur during the sample.

phase_boundaries_for_analysis.planning_start: root task/session start with the new specification
phase_boundaries_for_analysis.approval_1: user accepts outcome, chunks, granularity, dependencies/parallelism, assumptions, and exclusions
phase_boundaries_for_analysis.approval_2: user authorizes exact base, ledger materialization, and first assignment wave after validation
phase_boundaries_for_analysis.execution_end: PROJECT_COMPLETED, durable blocker, or explicit user stop
separate_metrics: planning Sol/high input, output, token events, turns, and compactions
execution Sol/high and Terra/medium usage per integrated task
per-task criteria, requirements, dependencies, files, changed lines, submissions, corrections, and execution windows
recover, resume, worker-context, and review-context calls
rejections, corrections, blockers, uncertain operations, and verified requirements

comparison_controls.auto_review: report separately and do not attribute a changed approval mode to Taskledger
comparison_controls.model_policy: Compare exact model/reasoning cohorts; do not extrapolate lower-tier tokens into hypothetical higher-tier behavior.
comparison_controls.task_matching_policy: Use repeated sibling or same-family tasks as the primary comparison. Architecture-versus-endpoint and raw integrated-task comparisons are context only; do not collapse complexity into one score.
